protected_sources_observed.boundary: Unsupported methodology claims remain unresolved; the input contract adds no protected rule or classification.
The protocol represents parent, child and lower-child structure, requires subdivisions and degree consistency, and recurses into internals; an input binding itself proves none of those checks.
Protected normal-impulse rules refer to Wave 1-5 positions, but these references were not promoted into shared slot vocabulary or pattern validity.
Parent-child order, recursive child inspection and direct-child degree consistency are protected concepts; this contract records only untrusted identity and tuple order.

locked_runtime_identity_policy.subject_identity: Exact live AnalyzedWaveSubject object identity; subject_id is audit text only.
locked_runtime_identity_policy.binding_identity: Exact live OrderedChildBinding object identity; binding_id is audit text only.
locked_runtime_identity_policy.parent_reference: The exact supplied parent object is retained without proving parentage.
locked_runtime_identity_policy.child_order: Exact tuple order is retained as pure ordinal order with no public Wave 1-5 vocabulary.
locked_runtime_identity_policy.zero_or_one_child: Allowed without completeness or cardinality meaning.
locked_runtime_identity_policy.duplicates: Parent-as-child, repeated exact child identity, and duplicate subject IDs within one binding are rejected as Runtime identity-safety policy.
locked_runtime_identity_policy.cross_binding_reuse: Allowed because every binding is a separate non-authoritative caller assertion.
locked_runtime_identity_policy.copy: copy and deepcopy preserve the same immutable live identity.
locked_runtime_identity_policy.serialization: Pickle is rejected; JSON-compatible records and reconstructed objects are audit-only untrusted data.
